current_static_findings.evidence: 正常路径只要UploadTask进入内存mpsc就调用complete_upload复用TripleBuffer，尚无本地耐久屏障
current_static_findings.consequence: 队列发送后到本地持久化前的进程或节点崩溃会永久丢失已轮转PCAP

current_static_findings.evidence: 停机分支对upload_tx.send(task)调用ok丢弃错误，随后无条件complete_upload
current_static_findings.consequence: uploader已退出或channel关闭时，最后一批PCAP会被静默释放且不可恢复

current_static_findings.evidence: 本地缓存直接tokio::fs::write最终路径，未执行临时文件sync_data、原子rename和父目录fsync
current_static_findings.consequence: 断电或文件系统故障可留下截断文件、空目录项或journal与文件不一致

current_static_findings.evidence: 函数及spawn_recovery_task存在，但当前工作树没有任何运行时caller
current_static_findings.consequence: 重启后journal中的PENDING或对象已写入但metadata未确认记录不会自动恢复

current_static_findings.evidence: 恢复路径读取local_path后直接上传，未对compressed_size和sha256重新校验
current_static_findings.consequence: 截断、篡改或路径碰撞的缓存字节可被写入权威对象存储并继续推进状态

current_static_findings.evidence: 清理按目录mtime排序删除最老30%普通文件，不读取UploadJournal状态，也不区分pending和cleanup-authorized
current_static_findings.consequence: 磁盘压力可删除尚未上传或metadata未确认的唯一耐久副本

current_static_findings.evidence: local_path和对象key主要由ts_start与ts_end构造，缺少稳定capture或spool UUID
current_static_findings.consequence: 同时间窗重试、并发轮转或时钟碰撞可覆盖本地证据并混淆对象identity

current_static_findings.evidence: UploadData只复制buffer中packet records，未在移交数据前合成PCAP global header
current_static_findings.consequence: 上传对象可能不是可独立解析的标准PCAP文件，恢复验证也缺少格式权威

current_static_findings.evidence: task_id不存在时仅warn并仍返回Ok，调用方无法区分状态已耐久与记录缺失
current_static_findings.consequence: 对象或metadata成功后可能被误认为journal同步成功，形成不可恢复的事实分叉

current_static_findings.evidence: 对象写入、journal mark和metadata RPC分属独立副作用，当前receipt不足以证明远端对象版本和同一manifest
current_static_findings.consequence: 任一崩溃窗口可重复上传对象或用错误对象事实重试metadata，无法证明端到端幂等

transitions.durability_barrier: complete bytes and canonical manifest computed
file sync_data plus atomic rename plus parent directory fsync
sled record and flush contains immutable path size hash and identity
receipt and state stored in one sled batch and flush
gateway ACK identity and receipt hash match journal
cleanup authorization is durable and audit-visible
file removal and parent directory fsync complete
spool bytes and manifest remain unchanged
corrupt evidence retained with typed reason

invariants: TripleBuffer cannot be reused before SPOOL_DURABLE and JOURNALED_PENDING are both proven
every durable spool identity includes tenant probe capture UUID manifest size and sha256
a recoverable local file is verified against journal size and hash before any object write
OBJECT_WRITTEN requires a real SDK or trusted HEAD receipt bound to the same key and manifest
metadata retries after OBJECT_WRITTEN never upload the object again
DiskMonitor may delete only CLEANUP_AUTHORIZED files and never infer authorization from age
shutdown stops capture then seals and spools then drains upload claims before closing dependencies
a PCAP spool contains one valid global header followed only by complete packet records

function_contracts.signature_after: pub async fn upload_journaled(&self, upload: JournaledUploadRef) -> Result<UploadResult>
function_contracts.responsibility: 只消费已经SPOOL_DURABLE且JOURNALED_PENDING的不可变引用，并按receipt推进对象与metadata状态
body_steps: B01 reload journal entry by immutable task ID and compare the full manifest
B02 claim the pending revision without reading mutable UploadTask bytes
B03 verify local size and sha256 before object upload
B04 obtain and durably store ObjectWriteReceipt before metadata RPC
B05 reuse stored receipt for metadata-only retry and authorize cleanup only after ACK
error_branches: missing or conflicting journal identity returns typed corruption and keeps evidence
local hash mismatch quarantines without object write
metadata failure retains OBJECT_WRITTEN and the local spool
function_contracts.atomicity: remote effects are separated by journal flush barriers; no remote call is labeled durable before its receipt transition commits
function_contracts.idempotency: the same JournaledUploadRef always addresses the same spool hash object key and journal task ID
function_contracts.rollback: disable new producer first, retain every new-format journal and spool, then let the compatible consumer drain or export them

B02 prepend exactly one canonical PCAP global header and compute capture UUID plus manifest
B03 create_new a same-directory temporary file and write all bytes
B04 sync_data rename to content-bound final path and fsync the parent directory
B05 call record_spooled_pending and return only after sled flush

temp write or sync failure removes only the owned temp file and retains the buffer lease
journal failure retains the durable orphan for deterministic startup reconciliation
function_contracts.atomicity: filesystem publication and journal publication are ordered durability barriers with an explicit recoverable orphan state between them
function_contracts.idempotency: capture UUID plus manifest hash makes same bytes idempotent and same UUID with different bytes a conflict
function_contracts.rollback: stop rotator production and preserve all final spool files and journal records; cleanup only owned temporary files proven unpublished

function_contracts.responsibility: 只封存可移交buffer并保持upload lease，直到rotator确认引用已耐久而不以队列接收替代完成

B02 refuse rotation if any sealed upload lease remains outstanding
B03 move write index and seal the previous buffer without reset

outstanding lease returns false without overwriting data
completion index mismatch keeps the buffer sealed
function_contracts.atomicity: index publication uses acquire-release ordering and buffer reset happens only after the durability callback
function_contracts.idempotency: repeated rotate attempts while a lease is active cannot create another identity or reset the sealed bytes
function_contracts.rollback: stop capture and rotator, drain or persist the sealed lease, then restore old index behavior only with no outstanding new-format ref

function_contracts.responsibility: 以稳定task ID写入完整spool manifest和PENDING状态并flush，拒绝identity冲突
body_steps: B01 validate final path is confined beneath configured spool root
B02 derive stable task ID from tenant probe capture UUID and manifest hash
B03 compare any existing entry for exact manifest equality
B04 insert new versioned PENDING entry or return the identical existing entry
B05 flush sled before reporting success
error_branches: same task ID with different manifest is a typed conflict
path traversal or symlink escape is rejected
insert or flush failure returns error and never reports JOURNALED_PENDING
function_contracts.atomicity: the full entry is one sled value and success requires a completed flush
function_contracts.idempotency: an exact ref replays to the same task ID while any changed identity field is rejected
function_contracts.rollback: preserve versioned entries and keep the legacy record_pending reader compatible; do not downgrade or delete manifests

function_contracts.signature_before: async fn run_pcap_rotator( mut handle: ShutdownHandle, buffer: Arc<TripleBuffer>, upload_tx: mpsc::Sender<UploadTask>, tenant_id: String, probe_id: String, )
function_contracts.signature_after: async fn run_pcap_rotator(mut handle: ShutdownHandle, buffer: Arc<TripleBuffer>, spool: Arc<DurablePcapSpool>, upload_tx: mpsc::Sender<JournaledUploadRef>, tenant_id: String, probe_id: String)
function_contracts.responsibility: 执行rotate、耐久spool、journal flush、enqueue ref，再释放buffer；停机发送失败绝不静默

B02 call persist_rotated before any buffer completion

function_contracts.signature_after: async fn do_upload_to_s3_with_receipt(&self, key: &str, data: &[u8]) -> Result<ObjectWriteReceipt>

function_contracts.idempotency: conditional stable-key writes accept the same manifest and reject any different manifest

function_contracts.signature_after: pub fn mark_object_written(&self, task_id: &str, receipt: &ObjectWriteReceipt) -> Result<()>

B02 verify state permits transition from PENDING or idempotent OBJECT_WRITTEN
B03 compare key stored size sha256 tenant probe and capture identity
B04 write receipt and OBJECT_WRITTEN in one versioned entry

conflicting repeated receipt is quarantined
flush failure cannot report OBJECT_WRITTEN
function_contracts.atomicity: receipt and state share one serialized journal value and one required flush barrier
function_contracts.idempotency: the exact same receipt is a no-op success and any differing receipt is a conflict
function_contracts.rollback: keep the new receipt fields readable and never translate OBJECT_WRITTEN back to an unproven legacy s3_key-only state
